review.summary: A small, low-risk additive feature exposing math.exp2 to Numba's jit, following the existing log2/llvm.log2 precedent very closely. The mechanics are correct (LLVM has llvm.exp2, signatures mirror math.exp), and tests + docs are wired up. Main issues are stylistic / convention drift: inconsistent version-gating style (`sys.version_info` in impl, `PYVERSION` in tests), a PEP8 blank-line regression in mathdecl.py, a duplicated/no-op intrinsic registration in np/math/mathimpl.py (mirrors a pre-existing dead-code pattern in that file but should at least be acknowledged), a missing trailing newline in the news fragment, and an undocumented dependency on the LLVM toolchain shipping an llvm.exp2 lowering on the float32 path. No correctness blockers; recommend P1 cleanups before merge.

issues.description: Inconsistent Python-version gating style: uses sys.version_info in impl files but PYVERSION in test file
issues.detail: numba/core/typing/mathdecl.py and the two mathimpl.py files guard with `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):`, while numba/tests/test_mathlib.py guards with `PYVERSION >= (3, 11)` (imported from numba.core.utils). The rest of the codebase (asnumbatype.py, unicode.py, etc.) uses the PYVERSION constant exclusively, often as `PYVERSION in ((3, 10), (3, 11))`. Pick PYVERSION everywhere for consistency and to make it greppable. The added `import sys` in mathdecl.py becomes unnecessary once switched.

issues.description: PEP8 blank-line regression: closing `]` of Math_unary.cases is followed by `if sys.version_info...` with no blank line
issues.detail: Previously there was a blank line after `class Math_unary` (line 44) before the next `@infer_global(math.atan2)` class. The patch deletes that separator and inserts the `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` block flush against the class body. PEP8 expects two blank lines between top-level constructs. Add a blank line before the `if` and keep two blank lines before the next `@infer_global(math.atan2)` class.

issues.description: Registration in numba/np/math/mathimpl.py is effectively dead code; mirrors a pre-existing dead-code pattern but warrants explicit note
issues.detail: In numba/np/math/mathimpl.py the `@lower(...)` decorators inside `unary_math_intr` and `unary_math_extern` are commented out (lines 130, 166), and `lower` itself is not defined (the registry import is also commented out at line 21). The `exp2_impl = unary_math_intr(math.exp2, 'llvm.exp2')` line therefore registers nothing — it only constructs a closure and discards it. Either drop the np/math/mathimpl.py change entirely, or surface the fact that this file is dormant. As-is the diff suggests behavior that does not occur.

issues.description: News fragment is missing a trailing newline and uses a header style that does not match neighbors
issues.detail: docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst ends without a final newline (`\ No newline at end of file`), inconsistent with every other fragment in that directory. The header `Add support for ``math.exp2``.` ends with a period, while nearby fragments (e.g. 10131.highlight.rst) typically omit trailing punctuation in the header. Minor, but towncrier output consistency matters.

issues.description: Reassigning `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` is correct but stylistically unusual
issues.detail: Every other registration on Math_unary is done via stacked `@infer_global(...)` decorators above the class definition. The conditional reassignment idiom is the cleanest 3.11+ guard available, but a brief inline comment (`# math.exp2 added in Python 3.11`) would help future readers understand why this single function is registered out-of-band.

issues.description: Test coverage for math.exp2 misses domain edge cases (large positive, large negative, 0, inf, nan)
issues.detail: test_exp2 reuses the same x_values as test_exp: `[-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]`. exp2 is the natural place to validate that integer-power inputs (e.g. 10, 16, 32, 53) match the bit-exact result `2**n`, and that `exp2(inf)`, `exp2(-inf)`, `exp2(nan)` behave per spec. The current test only proves it's wired up; it doesn't probe the intrinsic's numerical contract.

issues.description: Negative literals passed to unsigned types in test data (carried-over pattern from test_exp)
issues.detail: x_values `[-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` are zipped with x_types that include uint16/uint32/uint64, so the negative values become large positive values via two's complement wrap. test_exp has the same shape so this is not a new defect, but copy-pasting it propagates a confusing test. Consider splitting signed and unsigned test runs.

issues.description: Implicit dependency on LLVM providing an llvm.exp2 lowering on float32
issues.detail: math.log2 is already lowered to llvm.log2 in cpython/mathimpl.py, so precedent exists, but it's worth confirming under the LLVM versions Numba's CI matrix targets that llvm.exp2.f32 lowers cleanly on all supported targets (CPU + any non-CUDA backends that read this registry). If a backend falls back to a libcall, ensure exp2f is linkable. A brief comment or a CI matrix note would harden the change.

dissents.topic: Whether to gate at all on Python 3.11+ vs drop 3.10 support and simplify

positions.position: Conditional guard is correct: Numba still supports Python 3.10 per setup.py (min_python_version='3.10'). The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` guard is necessary, even if ugly. Ship it.

Three near-identical version guards scattered across mathdecl.py, cpython/mathimpl.py, and np/math/mathimpl.py is a smell. A single helper (e.g. `_has_math_exp2`) or a centralized `numba.core.utils.PY_HAS_EXP2 = PYVERSION >= (3, 11)` would localize the knowledge and make future cleanup trivial when 3.10 is dropped.

dissents.topic: Whether the np/math/mathimpl.py change should be included

positions.position: Mirror every change made to cpython/mathimpl.py in np/math/mathimpl.py — even when np/math/mathimpl.py is currently dormant — so the two files stay in sync for when np/math/mathimpl.py is revived.

np/math/mathimpl.py has its `@lower(...)` decorators commented out and the registry import disabled. Adding a no-op line for exp2 increases diff size, masks the dead-code state of the file, and gives a false sense of coverage. Drop the np/math/mathimpl.py edit until that file is brought back to life.

dissents.topic: Whether reassigning Math_unary or using a different gating idiom is preferable

positions.position: `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` is the smallest, most surgical change and is functionally identical to the stacked-decorator form.

A conditional decorator built inside a tiny helper, or a `_exp2_targets = (math.exp2,) if PYVERSION >= (3, 11) else ()` then a loop applying `infer_global` over the tuple, scales better to future version-gated additions and removes the reassignment that breaks the class-decoration pattern.
